play_item.name: Play a Jellyfin item
play_item.description: Plays a Jellyfin movie, episode or video on a Google Cast TV through the official Jellyfin receiver, and waits until it plays. Give the item's id, or its name for the server to look up (a show plays one of its episodes). The response says ok, what was found, with the play method and session, or the error.

entity_id.name: TV
entity_id.description: Google Cast player of the TV (the cast entity, not a universal one). The list shows the cast players that can show video, without speakers or speaker groups.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: Jellyfin id of the movie, episode or video. Give this or a name.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of a movie, show, episode or video, looked up on the server as the token's user (case, accents and punctuation don't matter). A show plays one of its episodes. Give this or an item ID.

item_type.name: Item type
item_type.description: With an item ID: its Jellyfin type (default Video); an Episode makes the receiver queue the rest of the season when the user has next-episode autoplay on. With a name: only look for that type (Series = shows).

library.name: Library
library.description: With a name: only look in this Jellyfin library ("Movies", "TV Shows"...), named as the token's user sees it; case doesn't matter.

episode.name: Episode
episode.description: Which episode of a show found by name: next_up (the token user's next episode, or the first one once it was all watched) or random. Shuffle replaces it.

shuffle.name: Shuffle
shuffle.description: For a show (by name or by its id): play its episodes in random order until something else stops it, reshuffling each time they have all played (a queue of 200 episodes). Ignored for anything that isn't a show.

audio_stream_index.name: Audio track
audio_stream_index.description: Jellyfin stream index of the audio track (default: the server's choice).

subtitle_stream_index.name: Subtitle track
subtitle_stream_index.description: Jellyfin stream index of the subtitle track, -1 for none (default: the user's subtitle settings).

start_position_ticks.name: Start position
start_position_ticks.description: Where to start, in Jellyfin ticks (10,000,000 per second).

max_bitrate.name: Max bitrate
max_bitrate.description: Bitrate cap in bit/s (default: the receiver measures the network). It stays on the receiver until the app closes.

receiver_name.name: Receiver name
receiver_name.description: Device name of the Jellyfin session (default: the TV's name plus "Jellyfin"). Keep it stable per TV.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to wait for the TV to play it.

next_track.name: Next in the Jellyfin queue
next_track.description: Moves the Jellyfin receiver on a Google Cast TV to the next item of its own queue (a shuffled show, or the episodes it queued itself), and waits until it plays. Only while the Jellyfin receiver is on screen; the Cast integration offers no next/previous for it. The response says ok with what plays now, or the error.

entity_id.name: TV
entity_id.description: Google Cast media player playing the Jellyfin receiver (the cast entity, not a universal one).

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to wait for the TV to play the next item; with nothing there it answers with an error after this.

previous_track.name: Previous in the Jellyfin queue
previous_track.description: Moves the Jellyfin receiver on a Google Cast TV to the previous item of its own queue (a shuffled show, or the episodes it queued itself), and waits until it plays. Only while the Jellyfin receiver is on screen; the Cast integration offers no next/previous for it. The response says ok with what plays now, or the error.

entity_id.name: TV
entity_id.description: Google Cast media player playing the Jellyfin receiver (the cast entity, not a universal one).

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to wait for the TV to play the previous item; with nothing there it answers with an error after this.
